hook_line: DOW ERASES 1,100-POINT DROP TO CLOSE HIGHER

hook_stat.sub: Points the Dow was down at its session low before closing up 164.25 points

stats.label: Where the Dow closed, up 164.25 points or 0.33%
The Nasdaq fell more than 4% early before recovering to close down just 0.62%
HP's gain after its fourth-quarter revenue and profit beat analysts' estimates

diaspora_bullets: Value stocks beat growth on the day: the Russell 1000 value index rose 0.4% while growth fell 0.8%
US markets are closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving and close early on Friday
news_summary: The Dow erased an intraday loss of more than 1,100 points on Wednesday to close up 164.25 points at 50,182.95, as bargain hunters stepped in after an AI-led selloff and new US tariff proposals rattled markets ahead of Thanksgiving.
payoff: Despite Wednesday's recovery, the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 remained on track for their worst November since 2008.
